title: Gate — v0.1 beta exit
scope: Beta may be claimed only when every criterion is PASS on stored evidence (docs/qa/beta-exit.md). Until this gate is signed, the beta update channel does not move (release-channel.yml).

criteria.criterion: Fidelity register: same-Provider pairs PASS on every area; cross-Provider pairs PASS or FAIL with a user-facing drop list — from live runs on real binaries
Dogfood programme: ≥ 80 % unaided task completion; ≥ 80 % A→B→A continuity; median switch < 2 min
Cleanup safety: zero false cleanup kills across the dogfood programme
Accessibility: the a11y gate green on measured evidence — axe on every gallery state, keyboard-complete core flows, contrast, no colour-only signals; the per-release VoiceOver pass
Performance: every AJ-E805 budget met or waivered, on measured values, including the release app on the reference Mac
Fleet security review (STRIDE) passed and signed
Visual regression gate green against approved baselines
Quality gates enforced in CI; no deselected check or re-threshold without a recorded decision (the flake ledger)
Signed, notarized release built by the release workflow, with the updater's tampered-artifact rejection shown
Gate packet complete: every criterion links resolving evidence; this gate signed with date, commit and reviewer
